lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tribhavan so prabh jaaneeai saacho saachai naai ||5||
lines.translation: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan kharee suhaavanee jin pir jaataa sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalee mahal bulaaeeai so pir raave ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lord ravishes her with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sach suhaagan saa bhalee pir mohee gun sa(n)g ||6||
lines.translation: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of her Husband Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਾ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolee bhoolee thal chaRaa thal chaR doogar jaau ||
lines.translation: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed the plateau, I go up the mountain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ban mahi bhoolee je phiraa bin gur boojh na paau ||
lines.translation: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without the Guru, I do not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naavahu bhoolee je phiraa phir phir aavau jaau ||7||
lines.translation: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਧਾਊਆ ਚਲੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: puchhahu jaai padhaaooaa chale chaakar hoi ||
lines.translation: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajan jaanahi aapanaa dar ghar thaak na hoi ||
lines.translation: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak eko rav rahiaa doojaa avar na koi ||8||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te niramal jaaneeai niramal deh sareer ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal saacho man vasai so jaanai abh peer ||
lines.translation: The Pure, True Lord abides within the mind; He knows the pain of our hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sahajai te sukh agalo naa laagai jam teer ||1||
lines.translation: With intuitive ease, a great peace is found, and the arrow of death shall not strike you. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee re mail naahee niramal jal naai ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, filth is washed away by bathing in the Pure Water of the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal saachaa ek too hor mail bharee sabh jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You alone are Perfectly Pure, O True Lord; all other places are filled with filth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa ma(n)dar sohanaa keeaa karanaihaar ||
lines.translation: The Temple of the Lord is beautiful; it was made by the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: rav sas deep anoop jot tribhavan jot apaar ||
lines.translation: The sun and the moon are lamps of incomparably beautiful light. Throughout the three worlds, the Infinite Light is pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: haat patan gaR kothaRee sach saudaa vaapaar ||2||
lines.translation: In the shops of the city of the body, in the fortresses and in the huts, the True Merchandise is traded. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan a(n)jan bhai bha(n)janaa dekh nira(n)jan bhaai ||
lines.translation: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is the destroyer of fear; through love, the Pure One is seen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gupat pragat sabh jaaneeai je man raakhai thaai ||
lines.translation: The mysteries of the seen and the unseen are all known, if the mind is kept centered and balanced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa satigur je milai taa sahaje lae milaai ||3||
lines.translation: If one finds such a True Guru, the Lord is met with intuitive ease. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਰਖੇ ਹਿਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kas kasavatee laaeeai parakhe hit chit laai ||
lines.translation: He draws us to His Touchstone, to test our love and consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khote thaur na paainee khare khajaanai paai ||
lines.translation: The counterfeit have no place there, but the genuine are placed in His Treasury.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਉ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aas a(n)desaa door kar iu mal jaai samaai ||4||
lines.translation: Let your hopes and anxieties depart; thus pollution is washed away. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh kau maagai sabh ko dukh na maagai koi ||
lines.translation: Everyone begs for happiness; no one asks for suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੈ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhai kau dukh agalaa manamukh boojh na hoi ||
lines.translation: But in the wake of happiness, there comes great suffering. The self-willed manmukhs do not understand this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh sam kar jaaneeahi sabad bhed sukh hoi ||5||
lines.translation: Those who see pain and pleasure as one and the same find peace; they are pierced through by the Shabad. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਆਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed pukaare vaacheeai baanee braham biaas ||
lines.translation: The Vedas proclaim, and the words of Vyaasa tell us,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mun jan sevak saadhikaa naam rate gunataas ||
lines.translation: that the silent sages, the servants of the Lord, and those who practice a life of spiritual discipline are attuned to the Naam, the Treasure of Excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sach rate se jin gae hau sad balihaarai jaas ||6||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to the True Name win the game of life; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chahu jug maile mal bhare jin mukh naam na hoi ||
lines.translation: Those who do not have the Naam in their mouths are filled with pollution; they are filthy throughout the four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatee bhaai vihooniaa muhu kaalaa pat khoi ||
lines.translation: Without loving devotion to God, their faces are blackened, and their honor is lost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa avagan muthee roi ||7||
lines.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam are plundered by evil; they weep and wail in dismay. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਡਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat paaiaa dar kar milai milaai ||
lines.translation: I searched and searched, and found God. In the Fear of God, I have been united in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaanai ghar vasai haumai trisanaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Through self-realization, people dwell within the home of their inner being; egotism and desire depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਊਜਲੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak niramal oojale jo raate har naai ||8||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name of the Lord are immaculate and radiant. ||8||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun man bhoole baavare gur kee charanee laag ||
lines.translation: Listen, O deluded and demented mind: hold tight to the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jap naam dhiaai too jam darapai dukh bhaag ||
lines.translation: Chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; death will be afraid of you, and suffering shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dookh ghano dohaaganee kiu thir rahai suhaag ||1||
lines.translation: The deserted wife suffers terrible pain. How can her Husband Lord remain with her forever? ||1||
